inputs.learned_scores: arbitrary real scores/probabilities; never authority by themselves
inputs.support_state: per-action SUPPORTED / UNSUPPORTED / UNKNOWN within frozen validity region
inputs.hard_veto: per-action boolean from PROMOTED R2 fields only
inputs.domain_authorized: whether the case is inside the certified action surface

decision_order: Apply R2 hard veto only from PROMOTED fields within validity region.
An UNSUPPORTED action cannot be made legal by a learned score.
If all non-vetoed actions are UNKNOWN => ABSTAIN/REVIEW.
If multiple actions are SUPPORTED => preserve the full admissible set; learned scores are RANKING_HINT_ONLY.
If exactly one action is SUPPORTED and alternatives are explicitly UNSUPPORTED => singleton admissible set.
If typed veto eliminates every supported action => AUTHORITY_CONFLICT / REVIEW, not forced generation.
r11_constraint: For the certified R8 domain, 160/160 pairs have a same-stratum opposite-action witness; no scalar native preference may collapse those cases without new authority.
success: Hybrid is safer than pure learned argmax if it prevents unsupported/vetoed actions without erasing supported plurality.
